title: UI风格#190 - Ceramic Craft (陶瓷工艺)
description: 创建第190种UI风格：陶瓷工艺风格 - 瓷器质感、釉面光泽、东方美学。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGH.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ceramic Craft style When color palette Then features porcelain white, celadon green, oxblood red
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FFFFF0 (瓷白), #6495ED (青瓷), #8B0000 (绛红), #F5F5DC (米色), #708090 (石紫)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ceramic Craft style When typography Then uses elegant serif: Cormorant, Playfair Display
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Cormorant (优雅), Playfair Display (经典), Noto Serif (东方)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ceramic Craft style When layout Then ceramic plate composition, glaze patterns, vessel shapes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：瓷盘构图、釉面图案、器皿形状

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ceramic Craft style When UI elements Then glaze shine, porcelain smooth, ink wash
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：釉面光泽、瓷质光滑、墨染效果

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ceramic Craft UI When functional Then includes artisan chat, kiln agents, craft stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：工匠聊天、窑炉代理、工艺统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ceramic Craft UI When copy Then uses craft: 'Kiln', 'Glaze', 'Fire', 'Mold'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'KILN. GLAZE. FIRE.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'FIRE'、'DEPLOY'→'MOLD'
